title: PE-DESIGN's own two-colour design written to every machine format as PE-DESIGN 11 exports it
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's own design (round 4, pe-refs-4): a 20 mm Lato "S" in satin, 800 RED, then a 10 x 8 mm fill rectangle in 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE, saved as PES and exported to every type its Export dialog offers. OpenStitch imports PE's PES as stitches and writes each format; the writes are compared with PE's exports needle for needle. PE-DESIGN's PEC section holds no zero-length stitch, while its machine exports keep the zero-length stitches of its own stitch data (a needle point at each jump's landing and two repeats in the S: 475 points in the DST, 471 in the PES), so those cannot come from the PES and the compare drops a stitch that repeats the previous needle point on both sides (issue #135). SHV and CSD are read only in OpenStitch; their readers are checked against PE's files in the formats tests.
